notes.title: Cuban dark fantasy metroidvania Saviorless gets an April release date
notes.notes:
If you're fond of the fairly specific blend of doomy theology, rich art direction and Soulslike-tinted metroidvaning encapsulated by Blasphemous, you might also enjoy Saviorless from Cuban team Empty Head Games and publisher Dear Villagers, which now has a PC release date of 2nd April.

Read more

Hi community,

Thanks for all your feedback & participation on our demo (even though it's been a long time). 

We are happy to announce that the cuba's first indie game Saviorless releases on [u][b]April 2nd[/b][/u]!

If you don't want to be spoiled, let's sum it up in one sentence:

Saviorless is a stylish dark fantasy action-platformer with stunning hand-drawn art and animation.

In a word, it's Cuba's first indie masterpiece. 

Feel free to add the game to your wishlist and follow us!
